review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run (music-census.json) that re-executes M01's music cue chain — recover → radio → lifecycle → complete-the-wakers → offer_cues — through the very code this task added. Claim is implemented only, not checked: no independent reviewer has looked at this run, no original executable ran and no person heard anything. MEASURED (retail, read-only): M01 declares 6 music-state block(s) over 5 distinct state(s) ({"music_battlesuccess_sg", "music_missionsuccess_sg", "music_prebattle_sg", "music_primaryobj_sg", "music_secondaryobj_sg"}), each waking only as a WAKE_OBJECTIVE_WHEN_I_COMPLETE effect; the drive served 6 request(s), one per block, each under the owner-ruled ContentKind::Music id over the labelled container's member, and the director answered every one. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED: the selection tables and rules are static image evidence (the finding's measured VAs), the container preference is the labelled choice #1438/#1465 made — which of ZBD/soundsh.zbd and ZBD/soundsl.zbd the original opens is unmeasured — and the RNG is the owner's labelled designed choice (the original's MSVCRT!rand stream is not the project's). Which completions the mission's own world-fact gates produce is the mission-model's question, not this task's: the harness substitutes `complete(index)` for the conditions holding, exactly the entry point the host calls. The cue's audibility is the F41-D listening gate and is not claimed. The 4 assertion(s) discovered under this task's own prefix are the tests of this report. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
